item_fishingrod_primitive_desc: A simple hazel switch with bone hook and gut line. Perfect for catching fish in shallow Meadows streams.
piece_bait_creel_desc: A woven wicker creel submerged in shallow waters. Chummed with fresh neck tail to attract and gather native fishing bait.
piece_fishnet_coastal_desc: A weighted net suspended in coastal waters to capture local freshwater and near-shore fish over time.
piece_fishnet_deep_desc: A heavy anchored deep-water net deployed from vessels to harvest pelagic ocean and deep shelf fish.
item_fish1_desc: A freshwater Perch. Can be roasted whole directly over a campfire cooking rack.
item_fish2_desc: A predatory Pike. Can be roasted whole directly over a campfire cooking rack.
item_fishingbait_desc: Common earthworms and grubs. Preferred by Meadows fish. Inhabitants of deeper biomes crave specialized regional baits.
tutorial_gc_primitiverod_text: A fine tool, Viking! But a bare hook tempts no fish in these waters. Construct a submerged Bait Creel along the shore to gather worms and grubs. Riverbank Necks provide the pungent meat needed to chum the creel and draw native bait inside!
tutorial_gc_baitcreel_text: A clever contraption, Viking! This submerged creel slowly gathers native bait from the surrounding waters. You must exercise patience while it works. Once bait has settled inside, extract it. Remember: each land's waters yield their own unique lures, and different fish crave distinct fare!
tutorial_gc_firstfish_text: Skål, angler! A fresh catch from the waters of the Tenth Realm. You may roast whole fish directly over your campfire cooking rack for hearty nourishment far superior to common game meat. Larger, storied fish will yield even greater bounty!
tutorial_gc_bait_meadows_text: Common earthworms and shoreline grubs. These simple morsels tempt the Perch and Pike native to the gentle streams and calm coasts of the Meadows. Fish of deeper, perilous lands will pay them no heed.
tutorial_gc_bait_forest_text: Pungent bait steeped in ancient forest moss and troll grease. The wary Trollfish that swim in the dark waters of the Black Forest are drawn to its earthy scent.
tutorial_gc_bait_swamp_text: A foul lure laced with leech blood and entrails. Only the hardy Giant Herring lurking beneath the murk of the sunken Swamps will strike at such rot.
tutorial_gc_bait_cave_text: Chilled with frost glands from high peaks. In the subterranean lakes hidden inside mountain frost caves, the elusive blind Tetra fish hunger for this freezing morsel.
tutorial_gc_bait_ocean_text: Scented with sea-chitin and serpent flesh. The great pelagic wanderers of the open sea—the Coral Cod and deadly Pufferfish—will ignore humble freshwater worms, but they cannot resist this ocean feast.
tutorial_gc_bait_plains_text: Barbed with Deathsquito needles and sweetened with cloudberry nectar. The sun-scaled Grouper inhabiting the warm coastal rivers of the Plains hunt eagerly for this sharp treat.
tutorial_gc_bait_mistlands_text: Infused with royal jelly and seeker carapace. Through the blinding mists of these jagged valleys, bioluminescent Anglerfish are lured by its sweet, radiant aroma.
tutorial_gc_bait_ashlands_text: Forged in sulfur stone and charred ash. In the boiling southern seas, the armored Magmafish swim through liquid fire; only this heat-tempered bait can survive their scalding strike.
tutorial_gc_bait_deepnorth_text: Woven with downy feathers and permafrost crystals. The legendary leviathans of the frozen northern wastes require a bait hardy enough to withstand endless winter.
